captions.instagram:
AI is built into most bookkeeping apps now. Use it for the busywork, and check the judgment calls.

✔️ Good at: suggesting categories and spotting duplicates for you to review.
✔️ Check it: anything about what's deductible or how much tax you owe.
✔️ The IRS (2026 Dirty Dozen list) says not to rely on AI for complex tax questions and to verify any numbers it gives you. Its June 2026 guidance tells tax pros they can't rely on AI alone either.
✔️ Keep Social Security numbers and bank details out of public chatbots.

Our guide covers where AI helps and where a person still decides.

sources.fact: IR-2026-30 (Mar. 5, 2026) Dirty Dozen: taxpayers should not rely on AI-generated responses to complex tax questions and should verify any calculations or information provided by AI; read 2026-10-30
